text:
ana-sales: Quick escalation — OrbitOne execs want a firm answer by EOD on two things: 1) committed pricing concession for a 12mo reserved pool, 2) data path assurance for EU-only workloads. POC is flailing on throughput in our demo cluster (they expect ~12k tokens/s sustained).
martin-se: Ack. I saw CPU/GPU queues spike during their long-run tests earlier. I can reproduce with their prompt set.
lina-gtm: Need a short script we can give them showing config and perf targets. Also the exec is pushing for a term sheet if we can commit margin-wise.
ben-eng: @martin-se can you paste the failing log snippet? curious if it's batching or kv-cache related.
martin-se: Here — logs compressed: 
```
2026-02-15T14:12:01Z worker-3 WARN batch_size exceeded target: 64 -> 128
2026-02-15T14:12:02Z kvcache miss rate 12% latency spike
2026-02-15T14:12:03Z oom attempt evicting kv shard
```
martin-se: Looks like continuous batching plus KV eviction under longer context.
ben-eng: Repro steps: run the workload with --seq-len 4096 and continuous-batching enabled. I pushed a quick change to reduce batch window.
kai-cto: If batching window is reduced, tail latency goes up. We need a tradeoff doc for OrbitOne — they care about p50 and sustained throughput, not p99.
nana-sales: @kai-cto it's Ana, not Nana ;) but noted.
lina-gtm: Can legal pre-clear a concession? ballpark they want 20% off list for a 12mo commit.
sara-legal: 20% is... aggressive. Need to see ARR, customer tier, and loss mitigation (e.g., non-refundable commit). Drafting clause: "12mo reserved commitment with 90-day non-cancellable period and usage true-up" — will send redline.
nana-sales: (sorry, typo) ana-sales: To be clear — OrbitOne would sign a 12mo with a 3-month ramp and commit to a baseline throughput. They expect demo parity with prod by start of contract.
martin-se: Ops suggestion: spin a dedicated demo pool in eu-west-1 with fixed pool=4 (A100-equivalent) and pinned quantized model. Quick command: 
```
redwood deploy --env demo-orbitone --pool-size 4 --region eu-west-1 --model q4f16/redwood-optimized
```
ben-eng: I'll create the pool and run their 6-hour soak. Expect results in ~2 hours.
ops-bot: deployment demo-orbitone triggered by ben-eng at 2026-02-15T14:20:45Z — pool=4, region=eu-west-1.
ben-eng: First run shows sustained 11.5k tokens/s with reduced batch window, p50 18ms p99 220ms. KV miss rate dropped to 3%.
martin-se: Good. Need to document config choices for reproducibility and a mitigation plan if we see KV pressure in prod (prefix caching + larger kv shard allocations).
lina-gtm: Can we convert this into an exec-facing one-pager? I can draft pricing comps. Need to know margin impact of 20% off.
sara-legal: Provide revenue estimate + contract clause; I will check regulatory/data residency language. OrbitOne insists on EU-only processing and audit logs for 7 years. That’s doable but may hit platform add-ons.
kai-cto: Platform note: EU-only processing path requires VPC private deploy or dedicated tenancy in our eu region. That adds ops surcharge. Call it out as separate line item.
nana-sales: Action items: 
- ben-eng: validate soak + paste perf report (ETA 2h)
- martin-se: write repro + config gist for customer (ETA 1h)
- sara-legal: draft concession language + data residency clause (ETA EOD)
- kai-cto: estimate ops surcharge for EU-only private path (ETA EOD)
- lina-gtm: draft one-pager + term sheet (ETA EOD)

lina-gtm: I'll loop in account exec next. Any objections to offering a 15-18% band initially until we see ARR?
sara-legal: 15-18% with non-refundable commit and usage true-up is acceptable from legal POV.
martin-se: Perf report will include the exact redwood deploy command and tuning knobs we used.
ben-eng: Uploading soak logs now -> https://redwood-internal/soaks/orbitone/1758881230/results.txt
ana-sales: Thanks team. If we land these items today we can get the exec signature tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: ten-minute triage call scheduled at 2026-02-15T15:00:00Z for OrbitOne presales — join link: https://meet.redwood/gs/orbitone-presales-15m
